article_content: Routinely, you tally the calories in your food intake, but persistent weight issues may arise. It could be that the secret to your struggle doesn't relate to your food choices, but rather your beverage consumption. Studies conducted by organizations like the RSPH show that a startling 75% of Brits aren't aware of the calories in their beloved alcoholic beverages. Regrettably, this has led to a slow and steady calorie intake from alcohol, prompting demands for drinks companies to disclose the caloric content of their drinks on the labels. Shirley Cramer, the chief executive of RSPH, has called on the EU health commissioner to tighten the regulations about information on the energy content of drinks. She believes that this much-needed amendment could significantly contribute towards combating the nation's weight-related issues. For example, a simple 2-3 units alcohol intake daily could sum up to a calorie intake of 6,000 in a month. Furthermore, it would lead to around two pounds weight gain focused primarily around your waist and hips.

Le secret pourrait ne pas se trouver dans votre choix diététique, mais peut-être dans votre consommation de boissons alcoolisées ? Les études menées par des organisations telles que l'RSPH montrent que 75 % des Britanniques ne sont pas conscients du nombre de calories contenus dans leurs boissons alcoolisées préférées. Malheureusement, cela a conduit à une consommation lente et progressive des calories provenant d'alcool. En conséquence, des appels sont faits aux entreprises de boissons pour fournir des informations sur le contenu calorique des boissons alcoolisées sur l'étiquette. La directrice générale de l'RSPH, Shirley Cramer, appelle le commissaire de santé de l'UE à renforcer les réglementations concernant les informations sur l'énergie contenue dans les boissons. Elle suppose que cette modification cruciale pourrait contribuer de manière significative à combattre les problèmes de poids associés à notre nation. Par exemple, une simple consommation de 2-3 unités d'alcool quotidiennement peut se traduire par une consommation d'environ 6 000 calories en un mois, conduisant à un gain de poids d'environ deux livres, principalement autour de votre taille ou de vos hanches.

article_content: In a horrifying event, at least four people lost their lives in a deadly gas explosion at a shopping mall in Luzhou, Sichuan province. Rescuers who have been working tirelessly since the explosion began around midnight, worked until 2 am to evacuate and treat the injured. While the cause of the explosion is still uncertain, it may have resulted from a gas leak, a structural fault, or a previously unreported malfunction of mall equipment. The afflicted area, now scarred by fire and heavy smoke, offers no respite to the emergency responders yet. Time will come to understand the chain of events that led to this catastrophe.

article_content: Matt Aldridge, a former competitive power-lifter, and his wife Renee have been regular patients at the Shriners Hospital for Children in Greenville, South Carolina. Their 28-year-old daughter, Maddie, was born without shinbones and also without a full set of fingers, having had four surgeries to improve her hand efficiency. Matt and Renee are dedicated Shriners, and they credit the free orthopedic care provided by the institution. However, there's uncertainty as the Shriners fraternity may decide to seek donations to close several hospitals, including the one in Greenville, due to a significant decrease in the endowment fund. These potential closures are a major concern for patients and support groups who value the high-quality, free-of-charge care offered by the hospitals, affecting families in many states. Recognizing the crisis, some boards are proposing alternatives, such as partnerships with non-Shriners hospitals, while others entertain the idea of accepting insurance or Medicaid.
